headline: Martin Marietta Reports Second-Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Second-Quarter Revenues Increase 21% to New Record Operational Efficiency Opportunities Expected to Drive $350 Million of Cash Flow Benefits Raises Full-Year 2026 Revenues Guidance and Reaffirms Adjusted EBITDA Guidance RALEIGH, N.C., July 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. (NYSE: MLM) (Martin Marietta or the Company), a leading national supplier of aggregates and other building materials, today reported results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.
